# exception replacement event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exceptionReplacementEvent`](gmeow-exceptionReplacementEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exceptionReplacementEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The replacement event for a rescheduled occurrence. Absent for a pure cancellation.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](../classes/gmeow-ScheduleException.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:exceptionReplacementEvent`](gmeow-exceptionReplacementEvent.md) from [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](../classes/gmeow-ScheduleException.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ScheduleException`](../classes/gmeow-ScheduleException.md), [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the moved-to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) of a rescheduled occurrence — the new placement that stands in for the one at [`gmeow:exceptionOriginalDate`](gmeow-exceptionOriginalDate.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it for a pure cancellation (leave it absent, with [`gmeow:exceptionType`](gmeow-exceptionType.md) [`gmeow:exceptionTypeCancellation`](../individuals/gmeow-exceptionTypeCancellation.md)) and avoid more than one (it is functional — one replacement per exception).

### How to use

- Set one replacement [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) carrying the new dated placement; absence (not a sentinel) is how a cancellation is distinguished from a reschedule.

### Examples

- ex:standupMoved [`gmeow:exceptionReplacementEvent`](gmeow-exceptionReplacementEvent.md) ex:standup0620.
